title: 01 · 自我介紹
q: Tell me about yourself.
qzh: 請介紹一下自己。
basic: I'm Henry Mao, an industrial and product designer with over ten years of experience. I've worked on computers, mice, bags, gaming chairs, and mobile accessories at ASUS. My strength is taking a design from an early idea through testing and into production.
basiczh: 我是 Henry Mao，有十年以上工業與產品設計經驗。我在 ASUS 做過電腦、滑鼠、包袋、電競椅與行動配件。我的強項是讓設計從初期想法，經過測試，走到量產。
advanced: I'm Henry Mao, an industrial and product designer with over ten years of experience. I've worked on computers, mice, bags, gaming chairs, and mobile accessories at ASUS. My strength is taking a design from an early idea through testing and into production. For example, I worked on the ASUS fragrance mouse and the ROG ERGO AIR backpack. I also led the ARCHER backpack project. I'm looking for a senior design role where I can stay involved in design and help the team solve product problems.
advancedzh: 我是 Henry Mao，有十年以上工業與產品設計經驗。我在 ASUS 做過電腦、滑鼠、包袋、電競椅與行動配件。我的強項是讓設計從初期想法，經過測試，走到量產。例如我參與 ASUS 香氛滑鼠與 ROG ERGO AIR 背包，也帶領 ARCHER 背包專案。我希望擔任資深設計師，持續投入設計，協助團隊解決產品問題。
coach: 順序是背景、強項、兩個案例、求職方向。不必列出所有產品。最後一句請確認符合目前目標。
phrasezh: 我是 Henry Mao，有十年以上工業與產品設計經驗。
我在 ASUS 做過電腦、滑鼠、包袋、電競椅與行動配件。
我的強項是讓設計從初期想法，經過測試，走到量產。

title: 02 · 求職動機
q: Why are you interested in this role and our company?
qzh: 為什麼對這個職位和我們公司有興趣？
basic: I'm interested in this role because it combines product design with real development work. My experience covers both electronics and accessories, and I enjoy working through the details that make a product possible. I was especially interested in your [product name] because of [one specific design detail].
basiczh: 我對這個職位有興趣，因為它結合產品設計與實際開發。我的經驗涵蓋電子產品與配件，也喜歡處理讓產品成真的細節。我特別注意到貴公司的［產品名稱］，因為它的［一項具體設計細節］。
advanced: I'm interested in this role because it combines product design with real development work. My experience covers both electronics and accessories, and I enjoy working through the details that make a product possible. I was especially interested in your [product name] because of [one specific design detail]. I'd like to understand how your team makes those decisions. I believe my experience with materials, prototypes, and production could be useful for this role.
advancedzh: 我對這個職位有興趣，因為它結合產品設計與實際開發。我的經驗涵蓋電子產品與配件，也喜歡處理讓產品成真的細節。我特別注意到貴公司的［產品名稱］，因為它的［一項具體設計細節］。我想了解團隊如何做這些決策。我相信材料、原型與量產經驗能為這個職位帶來幫助。
coach: 面試前補上公司的真實產品與一個具體觀察。不要只說「公司很有名」或臆測公司文化。
phrasezh: 我對這個職位有興趣，因為它結合產品設計與實際開發。
我的經驗涵蓋電子產品與配件，也喜歡處理讓產品成真的細節。
我特別注意到貴公司的［產品名稱］，因為它的［一項具體設計細節］。

title: 03 · 轉職方向
q: Why are you considering a new opportunity?
qzh: 為什麼考慮轉換工作？
basic: I've gained a wide range of experience at ASUS, from mobile accessories to gaming products. I'm grateful for the chance to work across different teams and product types. For my next step, I'd like to apply that experience to new design challenges and learn how another team develops products.
basiczh: 我在 ASUS 累積了從行動配件到電競產品的廣泛經驗。我很感謝能與不同團隊合作，接觸不同產品類型。下一步，我希望把這些經驗用在新的設計挑戰，了解另一個團隊如何開發產品。
advanced: I've gained a wide range of experience at ASUS, from mobile accessories to gaming products. I'm grateful for the chance to work across different teams and product types. For my next step, I'd like to apply that experience to new design challenges and learn how another team develops products. I'm looking for a role where I can take responsibility for design decisions and stay involved through development and production.
advancedzh: 我在 ASUS 累積了從行動配件到電競產品的廣泛經驗。我很感謝能與不同團隊合作，接觸不同產品類型。下一步，我希望把這些經驗用在新的設計挑戰，了解另一個團隊如何開發產品。我希望承擔設計決策責任，並持續參與開發與量產。
coach: 這是正向動機範例，須符合實際離職原因。若被追問，補充真實背景，不需要批評現任公司。
phrasezh: 我在 ASUS 累積了從行動配件到電競產品的廣泛經驗。
我很感謝能與不同團隊合作，接觸不同產品類型。
下一步，我希望把這些經驗用在新的設計挑戰，了解另一個團隊如何開發產品。

title: 04 · 設計強項
q: What is your biggest strength as a designer?
qzh: 你最大的設計優勢是什麼？
basic: My biggest strength is connecting design ideas with production needs. I can explore the product's look and user experience, then work through materials and sample testing with engineers and suppliers. The fragrance mouse is a good example.
basiczh: 我最大的強項是連結設計想法與量產需求。我能探索產品外觀與使用體驗，再與工程師及供應商處理材料和樣品測試。香氛滑鼠就是一個例子。
advanced: My biggest strength is connecting design ideas with production needs. I can explore the product's look and user experience, then work through materials and sample testing with engineers and suppliers. The fragrance mouse is a good example. Adding a scent feature also meant checking how the oils worked with the materials and internal parts. I stayed involved in those details and helped move the design toward production.
advancedzh: 我最大的強項是連結設計想法與量產需求。我能探索產品外觀與使用體驗，再與工程師及供應商處理材料和樣品測試。香氛滑鼠就是一個例子。加入香氛功能，也需要確認精油與材料、內部零件的相容性。我持續參與這些細節，協助設計走向量產。
coach: 只選一項最強的能力，並立即用案例證明。不要只回答 creative、hardworking、team player。
phrasezh: 我最大的強項是連結設計想法與量產需求。
我能探索產品外觀與使用體驗，再與工程師及供應商處理材料和樣品測試。
香氛滑鼠就是一個例子。

title: 05 · 成長目標
q: What skill would you like to improve?
qzh: 你還想加強哪一項能力？
basic: One area I'd like to keep improving is laptop development. I have more years of experience in accessories, and my recent Vivobook work has helped me learn more about laptop production. I worked with manufacturers on 3D changes, mockups, and color approval.
basiczh: 我想持續加強筆電開發能力。我的配件經驗較多，而近期的 Vivobook 工作讓我更了解筆電量產。我與製造商合作，處理 3D 修改、模型與顏色確認。
advanced: One area I'd like to keep improving is laptop development. I have more years of experience in accessories, and my recent Vivobook work has helped me learn more about laptop production. I worked with manufacturers on 3D changes, mockups, and color approval. I want to build a deeper understanding of how design choices affect the whole laptop. My next step would be to join technical reviews earlier and learn more from the engineering team.
advancedzh: 我想持續加強筆電開發能力。我的配件經驗較多，而近期的 Vivobook 工作讓我更了解筆電量產。我與製造商合作，處理 3D 修改、模型與顏色確認。我想更深入理解設計選擇如何影響整台筆電。下一步會更早參與技術評審，向工程團隊學習。
coach: 用真實成長方向回答，說明已有基礎及下一步。本題不把「太追求完美」當作缺點。
phrasezh: 我想持續加強筆電開發能力。
我的配件經驗較多，而近期的 Vivobook 工作讓我更了解筆電量產。
我與製造商合作，處理 3D 修改、模型與顏色確認。

title: 06 · 設計流程
q: Walk me through your design process.
qzh: 請說明你的設計流程。
basic: I start by understanding who will use the product and what problem we need to solve. Then I study competing products and explore ideas through sketches and 3D models. Physical samples help me check things that are hard to judge on a screen, such as comfort and fit.
basiczh: 我先了解誰會使用產品，以及要解決什麼問題。接著研究競品，透過草圖與 3D 模型探索想法。實體樣品讓我確認螢幕上難以判斷的舒適度與合適程度。
advanced: I start by understanding who will use the product and what problem we need to solve. Then I study competing products and explore ideas through sketches and 3D models. Physical samples help me check things that are hard to judge on a screen, such as comfort and fit. During development, I work with product managers, engineers, and suppliers to review materials and production limits. I refine the design as we learn more from testing.
advancedzh: 我先了解誰會使用產品，以及要解決什麼問題。接著研究競品，透過草圖與 3D 模型探索想法。實體樣品讓我確認螢幕上難以判斷的舒適度與合適程度。開發時，我與產品經理、工程師及供應商檢視材料與量產限制，再依測試結果修正設計。
coach: 不只背流程名稱，要說每一步的目的。也可用香氛滑鼠串起整段回答。
phrasezh: 我先了解誰會使用產品，以及要解決什麼問題。
接著研究競品，透過草圖與 3D 模型探索想法。
實體樣品讓我確認螢幕上難以判斷的舒適度與合適程度。

title: 07 · 使用者需求
q: How do you understand user needs?
qzh: 你如何了解使用者需求？
basic: I look at the situation in which people use the product. What are they carrying? How do they hold it?
basiczh: 我會觀察人們使用產品的情境。他們攜帶什麼？他們如何握持產品？
advanced: I look at the situation in which people use the product. What are they carrying? How do they hold it? What feels difficult or uncomfortable? For the ERGO AIR backpack, we looked at carrying comfort, weight balance, and laptop protection. Samples and feedback from internal testers helped us improve the design. That feedback was useful, but it wasn't the same as a large user study. I'd want broader testing before making claims about all users.
advancedzh: 我會觀察人們使用產品的情境。他們攜帶什麼？他們如何握持產品？哪些地方困難或不舒服？ERGO AIR 注重背負舒適度、重量平衡與筆電保護。樣品及內部測試回饋幫助改善設計，但這不等於大型使用者研究；要對所有使用者做結論前，我會希望有更廣泛的測試。
coach: 區分使用情境觀察、內部測試及正式使用者研究，不把內部回饋誇大成大規模研究。
phrasezh: 我會觀察人們使用產品的情境。
他們攜帶什麼？
他們如何握持產品？

title: 08 · 競品分析
q: How do you use competitor research?
qzh: 你如何運用競品分析？
basic: I use competitor research to understand the choices users already have. I compare features, size, materials, and the way each product presents itself. Then I look for a need we could address more clearly.
basiczh: 我用競品研究了解使用者已有哪些選擇。我比較功能、尺寸、材料，以及各產品如何呈現自己。接著找出我們能更清楚滿足的需求。
advanced: I use competitor research to understand the choices users already have. I compare features, size, materials, and the way each product presents itself. Then I look for a need we could address more clearly. On the G22 project, market research and a review of earlier compact desktops helped shape the product direction. The goal was to find a clear reason for the product to exist and turn that into design choices.
advancedzh: 我用競品研究了解使用者已有哪些選擇。我比較功能、尺寸、材料，以及各產品如何呈現自己。接著找出我們能更清楚滿足的需求。G22 的市場研究與前代小型桌機檢討協助確立產品方向。目的是找到產品存在的明確理由，轉化成設計選擇。
coach: 強調比較後做了什麼決策，不必宣稱找到了市場上完全不存在的機會。
phrasezh: 我用競品研究了解使用者已有哪些選擇。
我比較功能、尺寸、材料，以及各產品如何呈現自己。
接著找出我們能更清楚滿足的需求。

title: 09 · 香氛滑鼠
q: Tell me about the ASUS fragrance mouse.
qzh: 請介紹 ASUS 香氛滑鼠。
basic: The idea was to add a scent experience to an everyday computer mouse. My work included design concepts, hand-fit studies, 3D models, and physical samples. A key challenge was making sure the scent feature could work with the rest of the product.
basiczh: 概念是在日常電腦滑鼠中加入香氛體驗。我的工作包含設計概念、手部適配研究、3D 模型與實體樣品。關鍵挑戰是讓香氛功能與產品其他部分一起正常運作。
advanced: The idea was to add a scent experience to an everyday computer mouse. My work included design concepts, hand-fit studies, 3D models, and physical samples. A key challenge was making sure the scent feature could work with the rest of the product. I worked with product managers, engineers, and suppliers to test oils, containers, and materials. We checked their compatibility with plastic parts and internal electronics, and continued to refine the design for production.
advancedzh: 概念是在日常電腦滑鼠中加入香氛體驗。我的工作包含設計概念、手部適配研究、3D 模型與實體樣品。關鍵挑戰是讓香氛功能與產品其他部分一起正常運作。我與產品經理、工程師及供應商測試精油、容器與材料，確認它們和塑膠零件及內部電子元件的相容性，持續修正以準備量產。
coach: 開頭說明產品價值，再談自己的工作與技術難點。不要只介紹產品功能。
phrasezh: 概念是在日常電腦滑鼠中加入香氛體驗。
我的工作包含設計概念、手部適配研究、3D 模型與實體樣品。
關鍵挑戰是讓香氛功能與產品其他部分一起正常運作。

title: 10 · 功能價值
q: How did you know the fragrance feature added value?
qzh: 你怎麼知道香氛功能有價值，而不只是噱頭？
basic: The idea was to offer a more personal experience in an everyday office product. However, a new feature needs evidence beyond being interesting. Our development work tested materials and the product's physical design.
basiczh: 概念是讓日常辦公產品提供更個人化的體驗。不過，新功能需要的不只是有趣，還需要證據。我們的開發工作測試了材料與產品的實體設計。
advanced: The idea was to offer a more personal experience in an everyday office product. However, a new feature needs evidence beyond being interesting. Our development work tested materials and the product's physical design. To judge long-term value, I'd also want to know whether people keep using the scent feature and whether it affects their buying decision. I would separate those questions from technical testing, because proving that a feature works doesn't prove that people want it.
advancedzh: 概念是讓日常辦公產品提供更個人化的體驗。不過，新功能需要的不只是有趣，還需要證據。我們的開發工作測試了材料與產品的實體設計。要判斷長期價值，我也想知道人們是否持續使用香氛功能，以及它是否影響購買決定。我會區分這些問題與技術測試，因為能運作不代表使用者想要。
coach: 本題考設計判斷。清楚區分「已做的驗證」與「還希望取得的使用者證據」。
phrasezh: 概念是讓日常辦公產品提供更個人化的體驗。
不過，新功能需要的不只是有趣，還需要證據。
我們的開發工作測試了材料與產品的實體設計。

title: 11 · ERGO AIR
q: Which project best shows your approach to design?
qzh: 哪個專案最能代表你的設計方法？
basic: The ROG ERGO AIR backpack is a strong example. We applied ideas from hiking backpacks to a gaming laptop bag, especially lighter materials and weight balance. My work covered early product direction and design development.
basiczh: ROG ERGO AIR 背包是一個很好的例子。我們將登山背包的想法運用到電競筆電包，尤其是輕量材料與重量平衡。我的工作涵蓋早期產品方向與設計開發。
advanced: The ROG ERGO AIR backpack is a strong example. We applied ideas from hiking backpacks to a gaming laptop bag, especially lighter materials and weight balance. My work covered early product direction and design development. We reviewed laptop protection and carrying comfort, then improved the design through samples and internal feedback. The project received 2024 iF and Red Dot design awards. It shows how I connect a clear user need with materials and product design.
advancedzh: ROG ERGO AIR 背包是一個很好的例子。我們將登山背包的想法運用到電競筆電包，尤其是輕量材料與重量平衡。我的工作涵蓋早期產品方向與設計開發。我們檢視筆電保護與背負舒適度，透過樣品及內部回饋改善設計。專案獲得 2024 iF 與 Red Dot 設計獎，展現我如何把明確需求連結到材料與產品設計。
coach: 獎項是專案成果。若你個人最有成就感的是別案，可以替换案例，保留回答結構。
phrasezh: ROG ERGO AIR 背包是一個很好的例子。
我們將登山背包的想法運用到電競筆電包，尤其是輕量材料與重量平衡。
我的工作涵蓋早期產品方向與設計開發。

title: 12 · 個人貢獻
q: What was your personal contribution to that project?
qzh: 這個專案中，你個人到底負責什麼？
basic: On ERGO AIR, my contribution included early product planning and design development. I worked on how the bag could balance laptop protection with lighter materials and carrying comfort. I also worked through samples and feedback as the design developed.
basiczh: 在 ERGO AIR，我的貢獻包含早期產品規劃與設計開發。我處理如何兼顧筆電保護、輕量材料及背負舒適度。開發過程中，我也持續處理樣品與回饋。
advanced: On ERGO AIR, my contribution included early product planning and design development. I worked on how the bag could balance laptop protection with lighter materials and carrying comfort. I also worked through samples and feedback as the design developed. The final product was a team effort with product managers and suppliers. I can explain the design work I handled, while giving the team credit for the parts we developed together.
advancedzh: 在 ERGO AIR，我的貢獻包含早期產品規劃與設計開發。我處理如何兼顧筆電保護、輕量材料及背負舒適度。開發過程中，我也持續處理樣品與回饋。最終產品是與產品經理、供應商共同努力的成果。我能說明自己負責的設計工作，也會肯定團隊共同完成的部分。
coach: 作品集中準備一頁標示自己的範圍。若被追問某零件或決策，回答具體工作，不用籠統地說「全部」。
phrasezh: 在 ERGO AIR，我的貢獻包含早期產品規劃與設計開發。
我處理如何兼顧筆電保護、輕量材料及背負舒適度。
開發過程中，我也持續處理樣品與回饋。

title: 13 · G22桌機
q: Tell me about the ROG G22 desktop.
qzh: 請介紹 ROG G22 桌機專案。
basic: The G22 project focused on a compact gaming desktop. We reviewed the market and problems with earlier models to help define its direction. My work covered design development from concepts and 3D models to mockups and production details.
basiczh: G22 專案聚焦於小型電競桌機。我們檢視市場及前代機種的問題，協助定義方向。我的工作從概念與 3D 模型，延伸到實體模型及量產細節。
advanced: The G22 project focused on a compact gaming desktop. We reviewed the market and problems with earlier models to help define its direction. My work covered design development from concepts and 3D models to mockups and production details. I also worked on CMF, lighting, packaging, and related parts. The challenge was keeping the product's design consistent as it moved through development. It gave me experience connecting the main product with the details around it.
advancedzh: G22 專案聚焦於小型電競桌機。我們檢視市場及前代機種的問題，協助定義方向。我的工作從概念與 3D 模型，延伸到實體模型及量產細節。我也參與 CMF、燈光、包裝與相關零件。挑戰是開發過程中保持設計一致，讓我累積整合主產品與周邊細節的經驗。
coach: 不主張自己負責散熱工程或電子設計。設計整合與工程開發的責任要分清楚。
phrasezh: G22 專案聚焦於小型電競桌機。
我們檢視市場及前代機種的問題，協助定義方向。
我的工作從概念與 3D 模型，延伸到實體模型及量產細節。

title: 14 · ARCHER系列
q: How do you design a product family?
qzh: 你如何設計一個產品系列？
basic: I first define what the products should share and where they need to be different. On the ARCHER backpack project, I led the planning of four bag styles for different uses. They needed a shared design language, but each bag also needed a clear purpose.
basiczh: 我先定義產品之間應該共用什麼，以及哪裡需要不同。在 ARCHER 背包專案，我帶領四種不同用途包款的規劃。它們需要共同的設計語言，每款也要有清楚用途。
advanced: I first define what the products should share and where they need to be different. On the ARCHER backpack project, I led the planning of four bag styles for different uses. They needed a shared design language, but each bag also needed a clear purpose. I led workshops and guided the team through concepts and samples. We also planned future color and material updates so the family could continue to develop over time.
advancedzh: 我先定義產品之間應該共用什麼，以及哪裡需要不同。在 ARCHER 背包專案，我帶領四種不同用途包款的規劃。它們需要共同的設計語言，每款也要有清楚用途。我帶領工作坊，引導團隊完成概念與樣品，也規劃未來的顏色及材料更新，讓系列持續發展。
coach: 說出「共同識別」與「個別功能」的平衡，避免讓系列設計聽起來只是換尺寸與顏色。
phrasezh: 我先定義產品之間應該共用什麼，以及哪裡需要不同。
在 ARCHER 背包專案，我帶領四種不同用途包款的規劃。
它們需要共同的設計語言，每款也要有清楚用途。

title: 15 · ALLY量產
q: Tell me about a difficult production problem you worked on.
qzh: 請舉例說明你處理過的量產難題。
basic: On the ALLY case project, I joined during later development. The existing 3D design needed changes before it could move into mold making and production. I revised the design, worked on CMF, and reviewed several rounds of samples.
basiczh: 我在 ALLY 保護殼的後期開發加入。既有 3D 設計需要修改，才能進入開模與量產。我修改設計、處理 CMF，並檢視多輪樣品。
advanced: On the ALLY case project, I joined during later development. The existing 3D design needed changes before it could move into mold making and production. I revised the design, worked on CMF, and reviewed several rounds of samples. My role was to help turn the design into something that could be produced. This project shows why I stay involved after the concept stage. Important design work continues during sample reviews and production preparation.
advancedzh: 我在 ALLY 保護殼的後期開發加入。既有 3D 設計需要修改，才能進入開模與量產。我修改設計、處理 CMF，並檢視多輪樣品。我的角色是協助設計變成可生產的產品。這說明為何概念階段後我仍持續參與：樣品評審與量產準備中仍有重要的設計工作。
coach: 若主管追問「究竟哪個地方不能量產」，請用你真實處理的零件或製程回答。履歷未載具體原因，本稿不預設壁厚、脫模角等問題。
phrasezh: 我在 ALLY 保護殼的後期開發加入。
既有 3D 設計需要修改，才能進入開模與量產。
我修改設計、處理 CMF，並檢視多輪樣品。

title: 16 · 設計與成本
q: How do you balance design quality and cost?
qzh: 你如何平衡設計品質與成本？
basic: I would first identify which parts of the design matter most to the user. Then I'd compare options with the engineer and supplier, including their cost and effect on the experience. In the Zenfone 3 Aura Flip Cover project, I worked with suppliers on soft materials and molding methods while considering cost and appearance.
basiczh: 我會先找出設計中對使用者最重要的部分。接著與工程師和供應商比較方案，包含成本及體驗影響。在 Zenfone 3 Aura Flip Cover，我與供應商研究軟性材料及成型方式，同時考慮成本與外觀。
advanced: I would first identify which parts of the design matter most to the user. Then I'd compare options with the engineer and supplier, including their cost and effect on the experience. In the Zenfone 3 Aura Flip Cover project, I worked with suppliers on soft materials and molding methods while considering cost and appearance. That experience taught me to explore production choices early, while there is still room to adjust the design.
advancedzh: 我會先找出設計中對使用者最重要的部分。接著與工程師和供應商比較方案，包含成本及體驗影響。在 Zenfone 3 Aura Flip Cover，我與供應商研究軟性材料及成型方式，同時考慮成本與外觀。這讓我學到要及早探索製程選擇，趁設計還能調整時處理。
coach: 有取捨邏輯即可，不必虛構降低成本的百分比。準備一個真實的材料比較作為追問內容。
phrasezh: 我會先找出設計中對使用者最重要的部分。
接著與工程師和供應商比較方案，包含成本及體驗影響。
在 Zenfone 3 Aura Flip Cover，我與供應商研究軟性材料及成型方式，同時考慮成本與外觀。

title: 17 · CMF決策
q: How do you choose colors, materials, and finishes?
qzh: 你如何做 CMF 決策？
basic: I consider the user, the brand, and how the product will be made. A material needs to support the intended feel and work in actual use. I also want to see physical samples, because a rendering can't fully show texture or color.
basiczh: 我考慮使用者、品牌，以及產品如何製造。材料要支持預期感受，也要能適應實際使用。我也想看實體樣品，因為渲染圖無法完整呈現質感與顏色。
advanced: I consider the user, the brand, and how the product will be made. A material needs to support the intended feel and work in actual use. I also want to see physical samples, because a rendering can't fully show texture or color. My experience includes plastic parts, soft materials, and bag fabrics. On Vivobook projects, I worked on color approval and production appearance, where small differences between samples can affect the final result.
advancedzh: 我考慮使用者、品牌，以及產品如何製造。材料要支持預期感受，也要能適應實際使用。我也想看實體樣品，因為渲染圖無法完整呈現質感與顏色。我的經驗包含塑膠件、軟性材料與包袋布料。在 Vivobook，我參與顏色確認與量產外觀工作，樣品之間的小差異可能影響最終結果。
coach: 重點是選材依據與實物驗證。可拿一個樣品比較故事補充，而不是只說「符合品牌」。
phrasezh: 我考慮使用者、品牌，以及產品如何製造。
材料要支持預期感受，也要能適應實際使用。
我也想看實體樣品，因為渲染圖無法完整呈現質感與顏色。

title: 18 · 舒適度驗證
q: How do you test comfort and usability?
qzh: 你如何驗證舒適度與易用性？
basic: I use physical models to check the actions people need to perform. For a mouse, that includes hand fit and grip. For a bag, it includes carrying and reaching the contents.
basiczh: 我用實體模型確認人們需要做的動作。對滑鼠來說，包含手部適配與握感。對包袋來說，包含攜帶與拿取內容物。
advanced: I use physical models to check the actions people need to perform. For a mouse, that includes hand fit and grip. For a bag, it includes carrying and reaching the contents. On the Zenfone flip cover project, I used models to check comfort when using the fingerprint reader. I would define the task before testing and record what needs to change. I also recognize that different users may need different sizes or adjustments.
advancedzh: 我用實體模型確認人們需要做的動作。對滑鼠來說，包含手部適配與握感。對包袋來說，包含攜帶與拿取內容物。在 Zenfone 翻蓋保護套，我用模型檢查操作指紋辨識器的舒適度。我會在測試前定義任務，記錄需要修改之處，也理解不同使用者可能需要不同尺寸或調整。
coach: 前半段是已有案例，後半段是建議的方法表述。沒有正式測試樣本數時，不要自行補數字。
phrasezh: 我用實體模型確認人們需要做的動作。
對滑鼠來說，包含手部適配與握感。
對包袋來說，包含攜帶與拿取內容物。

title: 19 · 工程限制
q: What would you do if an engineer said your design could not be made?
qzh: 工程師說你的設計做不出來，你怎麼辦？
basic: I'd ask which part creates the problem and what the limit is. Is it the material, the process, the space inside, or the cost? Then I'd explain the user need behind the design and work on alternatives with the engineer.
basiczh: 我會問是哪個部分造成問題，以及限制是什麼。是材料、製程、內部空間，還是成本？接著說明設計背後的使用需求，與工程師一起研究替代方案。
advanced: I'd ask which part creates the problem and what the limit is. Is it the material, the process, the space inside, or the cost? Then I'd explain the user need behind the design and work on alternatives with the engineer. I'd use a sample or a model to compare the options when possible. My goal would be to keep the important design value while finding a solution the team can build.
advancedzh: 我會問是哪個部分造成問題，以及限制是什麼。是材料、製程、內部空間，還是成本？接著說明設計背後的使用需求，與工程師一起研究替代方案。可行時，用樣品或模型比較。目標是保留重要設計價值，同時找到團隊能做出的解法。
coach: 用 would 表達處理方式，不假裝曾發生一場具體衝突。可接 ALLY case 的開發經驗，但不捏造對話。
phrasezh: 我會問是哪個部分造成問題，以及限制是什麼。
是材料、製程、內部空間，還是成本？
接著說明設計背後的使用需求，與工程師一起研究替代方案。

title: 20 · PM意見分歧
q: How would you handle disagreement with a product manager?
qzh: 你與產品經理意見不同時，會如何處理？
basic: I'd first check whether we disagree about the goal or the solution. The product manager may be focused on cost, timing, or market needs, while I'm looking at the user experience. I'd make those concerns clear and compare the options against the same criteria.
basiczh: 我會先確認分歧是在目標，還是在解法。產品經理可能關注成本、時程或市場需求，而我關注使用體驗。我會釐清這些考量，並以共同標準比較方案。
advanced: I'd first check whether we disagree about the goal or the solution. The product manager may be focused on cost, timing, or market needs, while I'm looking at the user experience. I'd make those concerns clear and compare the options against the same criteria. If we still disagree, I'd suggest a focused test or review. Once a decision is made, I'd support the team and keep track of any remaining design risks.
advancedzh: 我會先確認分歧是在目標，還是在解法。產品經理可能關注成本、時程或市場需求，而我關注使用體驗。我會釐清這些考量，並以共同標準比較方案。若仍有歧見，就建議聚焦的測試或評審。決策確定後，我會支持團隊，持續追蹤剩餘設計風險。
coach: 核心是釐清分歧、共同標準、驗證及執行。若主管要求真實案例，換成實際發生過的事件。
phrasezh: 我會先確認分歧是在目標，還是在解法。
產品經理可能關注成本、時程或市場需求，而我關注使用體驗。
我會釐清這些考量，並以共同標準比較方案。

title: 21 · 設計回饋
q: How do you respond to critical design feedback?
qzh: 你怎麼面對負面的設計回饋？
basic: I'd try to understand the reason behind the feedback before defending the design. For example, “It doesn't feel right” could mean a problem with size, comfort, or brand identity. I'd ask for a more specific concern and compare it with the project goals.
basiczh: 我會先理解回饋背後的原因，再為設計辯護。例如「感覺不對」可能是尺寸、舒適度或品牌識別的問題。我會詢問更具體的疑慮，並對照專案目標。
advanced: I'd try to understand the reason behind the feedback before defending the design. For example, “It doesn't feel right” could mean a problem with size, comfort, or brand identity. I'd ask for a more specific concern and compare it with the project goals. If the feedback points to a real issue, I'd revise the design. If I see a trade-off, I'd explain it with a model or clear comparison and ask for a decision.
advancedzh: 我會先理解回饋背後的原因，再為設計辯護。例如「感覺不對」可能是尺寸、舒適度或品牌識別的問題。我會詢問更具體的疑慮，並對照專案目標。若回饋指出真實問題，就修改設計。若存在取捨，就用模型或清楚比較說明，請團隊做決策。
coach: 表現開放，同時保留設計判斷。接受批評不代表每一條意見都直接照做。
phrasezh: 我會先理解回饋背後的原因，再為設計辯護。
例如「感覺不對」可能是尺寸、舒適度或品牌識別的問題。
我會詢問更具體的疑慮，並對照專案目標。

title: 22 · 開發挫折
q: Tell me about a design that did not work as expected.
qzh: 請談一個沒有如預期發展的設計。
basic: One development challenge I can discuss is the ALLY case. I joined after the initial design, and the existing 3D model wasn't ready for production. I revised it and worked through several rounds of samples.
basiczh: 我可以談 ALLY 保護殼的開發挑戰。我在初期設計之後加入，當時的 3D 模型尚未能量產。我修改模型，並完成多輪樣品檢討。
advanced: One development challenge I can discuss is the ALLY case. I joined after the initial design, and the existing 3D model wasn't ready for production. I revised it and worked through several rounds of samples. I wouldn't describe the original design as my own mistake, but the experience reinforced an important lesson: a convincing concept still needs production checks. In future projects, I'd bring those checks in earlier to help the team find problems sooner.
advancedzh: 我可以談 ALLY 保護殼的開發挑戰。我在初期設計之後加入，當時的 3D 模型尚未能量產。我修改模型，並完成多輪樣品檢討。我不會把原設計說成自己的失誤，但這段經驗提醒我：有說服力的概念仍需要量產檢查。未來我會更早加入這些檢查，幫團隊提早發現問題。
coach: 這是開發挫折案例，並非你的個人失誤。若主管明確問「你自己的錯誤」，務必準備另一個真實事件：當時判斷、影響、補救、改變。不要硬套本題。
phrasezh: 我可以談 ALLY 保護殼的開發挑戰。
我在初期設計之後加入，當時的 3D 模型尚未能量產。
我修改模型，並完成多輪樣品檢討。

title: 23 · 多案優先順序
q: How do you manage several projects at the same time?
qzh: 多個專案同時進行時，你如何安排優先順序？
basic: I'd compare deadlines, project risks, and what other people are waiting for. A sample review that blocks tooling may need attention before an early concept presentation. I'd break each project into clear next steps and confirm priorities with the team lead.
basiczh: 我會比較期限、專案風險，以及別人正在等什麼。阻礙開模的樣品評審，可能比早期概念簡報更需要優先處理。我會把各專案拆成清楚的下一步，與主管確認優先順序。
advanced: I'd compare deadlines, project risks, and what other people are waiting for. A sample review that blocks tooling may need attention before an early concept presentation. I'd break each project into clear next steps and confirm priorities with the team lead. If two deadlines conflict, I'd raise the issue early and explain the choices. My background covers several product types, so I'm familiar with projects that need very different kinds of design work.
advancedzh: 我會比較期限、專案風險，以及別人正在等什麼。阻礙開模的樣品評審，可能比早期概念簡報更需要優先處理。我會把各專案拆成清楚的下一步，與主管確認優先順序。若期限衝突，我會及早提出並說明選擇。我的背景涵蓋不同產品，因此熟悉差異很大的設計工作。
coach: 重點是優先順序的判準，不只說自己會加班。此工作方法請依你的實際習慣調整。
phrasezh: 我會比較期限、專案風險，以及別人正在等什麼。
阻礙開模的樣品評審，可能比早期概念簡報更需要優先處理。
我會把各專案拆成清楚的下一步，與主管確認優先順序。

title: 24 · 工作坊帶領
q: How do you lead a design workshop and support other designers?
qzh: 你如何帶領工作坊並協助其他設計師？
basic: On the ARCHER backpack project, I led workshops and guided designers through concepts, samples, and production preparation. We needed four bags with different uses and a shared design language. I helped turn those needs into design directions and shared my knowledge of materials and manufacturing.
basiczh: 在 ARCHER 背包專案，我帶領工作坊，引導設計師完成概念、樣品及量產準備。我們需要四款用途不同、但設計語言一致的包。我協助把需求轉成設計方向，分享材料與製造知識。
advanced: On the ARCHER backpack project, I led workshops and guided designers through concepts, samples, and production preparation. We needed four bags with different uses and a shared design language. I helped turn those needs into design directions and shared my knowledge of materials and manufacturing. For future workshops, I'd also make the expected output clear at the start and leave time to explain why each idea should move forward.
advancedzh: 在 ARCHER 背包專案，我帶領工作坊，引導設計師完成概念、樣品及量產準備。我們需要四款用途不同、但設計語言一致的包。我協助把需求轉成設計方向，分享材料與製造知識。未來的工作坊，我也會在開始時說清楚預期產出，留時間解釋每個想法為何值得往下發展。
coach: 區分專案帶領與人事管理。不把工作坊經驗說成帶領正式直屬部門。
phrasezh: 在 ARCHER 背包專案，我帶領工作坊，引導設計師完成概念、樣品及量產準備。
我們需要四款用途不同、但設計語言一致的包。
我協助把需求轉成設計方向，分享材料與製造知識。

title: 25 · 資深設計師
q: What makes you ready for a senior designer role?
qzh: 你為什麼能勝任資深設計師？
basic: I can take responsibility beyond the first design proposal. My experience includes product planning, materials, prototype reviews, and production support. I've also led a product family project and worked across design, engineering, product management, and suppliers.
basiczh: 我能承擔初期設計提案以外的責任。我的經驗包含產品規劃、材料、原型評審及量產支援。我也帶領過產品系列專案，與設計、工程、產品管理及供應商合作。
advanced: I can take responsibility beyond the first design proposal. My experience includes product planning, materials, prototype reviews, and production support. I've also led a product family project and worked across design, engineering, product management, and suppliers. I understand that a senior designer needs to explain decisions and help the team move forward. I can contribute through hands-on design while sharing experience that helps others avoid problems during development.
advancedzh: 我能承擔初期設計提案以外的責任。我的經驗包含產品規劃、材料、原型評審及量產支援。我也帶領過產品系列專案，與設計、工程、產品管理及供應商合作。我理解資深設計師需要解釋決策並幫團隊前進。我能親自投入設計，也分享經驗，協助他人避免開發問題。
coach: 用工作深度與責任證明資深，而不只是強調年資。準備 ARCHER 與 ALLY 兩個不同角色的例子。
phrasezh: 我能承擔初期設計提案以外的責任。
我的經驗包含產品規劃、材料、原型評審及量產支援。
我也帶領過產品系列專案，與設計、工程、產品管理及供應商合作。

title: 26 · AI應用
q: How do you use AI in your design work?
qzh: 你如何把 AI 用在設計工作中？
basic: I've used generative AI to explore early ideas for laptop and handheld gaming projects, and I've shared methods with the team. It gives me more visual directions to discuss. I still need to judge whether those ideas fit the user, the brand, and the product limits.
basiczh: 我曾用生成式 AI 探索筆電與掌上電競產品的早期想法，也和團隊分享方法。它提供更多可以討論的視覺方向。我仍需要判斷這些想法是否符合使用者、品牌與產品限制。
advanced: I've used generative AI to explore early ideas for laptop and handheld gaming projects, and I've shared methods with the team. It gives me more visual directions to discuss. I still need to judge whether those ideas fit the user, the brand, and the product limits. An AI image isn't a production-ready design. I'd take a useful idea into 3D development and physical testing before treating it as a workable solution.
advancedzh: 我曾用生成式 AI 探索筆電與掌上電競產品的早期想法，也和團隊分享方法。它提供更多可以討論的視覺方向。我仍需要判斷這些想法是否符合使用者、品牌與產品限制。AI 圖像不等於可量產設計。我會把有用的想法帶進 3D 開發與實體測試，再判斷是否可行。
coach: 說清楚 AI 用在哪個階段、由你做什麼判斷。工具名稱及使用熟練度請按實際情況補充。
phrasezh: 我曾用生成式 AI 探索筆電與掌上電競產品的早期想法，也和團隊分享方法。
它提供更多可以討論的視覺方向。
我仍需要判斷這些想法是否符合使用者、品牌與產品限制。

title: 27 · 衡量成功
q: How do you know if a design is successful?
qzh: 你如何衡量設計成功？
basic: I'd look at whether the design meets the user need, reaches the intended quality, and can be produced within the project limits. I'd also review user feedback and business results with the relevant teams. ERGO AIR received design awards, which recognized the project.
basiczh: 我會看設計是否滿足使用需求、達到預期品質，以及能否在專案限制內生產。我也會和相關團隊檢視使用者回饋與商業成果。ERGO AIR 得到設計獎，是對專案的肯定。
advanced: I'd look at whether the design meets the user need, reaches the intended quality, and can be produced within the project limits. I'd also review user feedback and business results with the relevant teams. ERGO AIR received design awards, which recognized the project. However, awards are only one part of the picture. I'd still want to understand comfort in daily use, long-term quality, and customer response before judging the full result.
advancedzh: 我會看設計是否滿足使用需求、達到預期品質，以及能否在專案限制內生產。我也會和相關團隊檢視使用者回饋與商業成果。ERGO AIR 得到設計獎，是對專案的肯定。但獎項只是其中一部分。要判斷完整成果，我仍希望了解日常舒適度、長期品質及顧客反應。
coach: 區分已知成果與希望追蹤的指標。不要把獎項直接當成銷量或滿意度證明。
phrasezh: 我會看設計是否滿足使用需求、達到預期品質，以及能否在專案限制內生產。
我也會和相關團隊檢視使用者回饋與商業成果。
ERGO AIR 得到設計獎，是對專案的肯定。

title: 28 · 跨國合作
q: How would you work with a global team?
qzh: 你會如何與跨國團隊合作？
basic: I'd use clear visuals and simple language to explain design decisions. Before a review, I'd share the goal, the options, and the questions we need to answer. Afterward, I'd confirm the decision, the owner of each task, and the next step in writing.
basiczh: 我會用清楚的圖像與簡單語言說明設計決策。評審前，先分享目標、方案與需要回答的問題。評審後，用文字確認決策、各任務負責人及下一步。
advanced: I'd use clear visuals and simple language to explain design decisions. Before a review, I'd share the goal, the options, and the questions we need to answer. Afterward, I'd confirm the decision, the owner of each task, and the next step in writing. If I didn't understand a comment, I'd ask for clarification. My experience working across design, engineering, and suppliers gives me a useful base for that kind of teamwork.
advancedzh: 我會用清楚的圖像與簡單語言說明設計決策。評審前，先分享目標、方案與需要回答的問題。評審後，用文字確認決策、各任務負責人及下一步。若不懂某個意見，我會請對方說清楚。跨設計、工程與供應商的合作經驗，是這類團隊工作的基礎。
coach: 這是預計採用的合作方法，不主張未記載的跨國團隊領導經驗。能問清楚比假裝聽懂更重要。
phrasezh: 我會用清楚的圖像與簡單語言說明設計決策。
評審前，先分享目標、方案與需要回答的問題。
評審後，用文字確認決策、各任務負責人及下一步。

title: 29 · 前90天
q: What would you focus on in your first 90 days?
qzh: 加入後的前 90 天，你會先做什麼？
basic: In the first month, I'd learn about the users, the product line, and the team's process. I'd review current projects and understand the main design and production challenges. In the second month, I'd aim to contribute to a clearly defined project and build working relationships with the key teams.
basiczh: 第一個月，我會了解使用者、產品線與團隊流程。我會檢視現有專案，了解主要設計與量產挑戰。第二個月，我希望參與範圍明確的專案，與關鍵團隊建立合作關係。
advanced: In the first month, I'd learn about the users, the product line, and the team's process. I'd review current projects and understand the main design and production challenges. In the second month, I'd aim to contribute to a clearly defined project and build working relationships with the key teams. By the third month, I'd want to take responsibility for a design task and review my progress with my manager. I'd adjust this plan to the team's priorities.
advancedzh: 第一個月，我會了解使用者、產品線與團隊流程。我會檢視現有專案，了解主要設計與量產挑戰。第二個月，我希望參與範圍明確的專案，與關鍵團隊建立合作關係。第三個月，我希望承擔一項設計任務，與主管檢視進度，並依團隊優先事項調整計畫。
coach: 強調了解現況後交付具體工作，不承諾三個月內完成整個產品上市。
phrasezh: 第一個月，我會了解使用者、產品線與團隊流程。
我會檢視現有專案，了解主要設計與量產挑戰。
第二個月，我希望參與範圍明確的專案，與關鍵團隊建立合作關係。

title: 30 · 反問主管
q: Do you have any questions for me?
qzh: 你有什麼問題想問我？
basic: Yes, thank you. What is the most important design problem you want this person to help solve? I'd also like to understand how designers stay involved from early concepts through production.
basiczh: 有，謝謝您。您最希望這個職位協助解決什麼設計問題？我也想了解，設計師如何從初期概念持續參與到量產。
advanced: Yes, thank you. What is the most important design problem you want this person to help solve? I'd also like to understand how designers stay involved from early concepts through production. Finally, what would make you say, after six months, that the person in this role is doing well?
advancedzh: 有，謝謝您。您最希望這個職位協助解決什麼設計問題？我也想了解，設計師如何從初期概念持續參與到量產。最後，六個月後，您會根據哪些表現，認為這個職位的人做得很好？
coach: 實際面談一次問一題，聽完再追問。三題分別了解職務任務、設計參與深度與績效期待。
phrasezh: 有，謝謝您。
您最希望這個職位協助解決什麼設計問題？
我也想了解，設計師如何從初期概念持續參與到量產。
